# Atomic notes

## Why this matters

One idea per note, linked, so a revision stays cheap. This paragraph carries the
block id that [[index#^why-block]] style references point at. ^why-block

- [ ] an open task inside a vault note
- [x] a finished task inside a vault note

The heading above is the target of [[index]]'s heading anchor, and the block id
above is the target of its block reference.
